simple.meaning: כׇּרְסֵא (korçêʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “a throne.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: כׇּרְסֵא (H3764) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 5:20, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to כׇּרְסֵא (H3764) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in כׇּרְסֵא (H3764) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: כׇּרְסֵא (korçêʼ) / H3764 is traced through Daniel 5:20, Daniel 7:9 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H3764. korse כָּרְסֵא (K §§ 11, 4 b) c); 62 ) noun masculine Dan 7:9 a throne ; — construct ׳כ 5:20 ; suffix כָּרְסְיֵהּ 7:9 b; plural absolute כָּרְסְוָן 7:9 a. כסדי see כַּשְׂדָּי .

occurrences.englishText: But when his heart was lifted up, and his spirit was hardened so that he dealt proudly, he was deposed from his kingly throne, and they took his glory from him.
